title: 第9章 周凌雪的威胁第10章 一杯茶
content_zh:
第9章周凌雪的威胁“大长老且慢！”
有数位长老走出，阻止大长老。
萧沉的话，让他们的内心犹如枯木逢春，心中的激动难以自抑。
他们被困苦海八重境数年甚至数十年，做梦都想要打破这一桎梏。
“是真的，是在萧兄的帮助下，我才突破到苦海境七重。”
白念冰开口，同时身上气息流转，境界展露无遗。
“我记得念冰两个月前才晋入苦海境六重，短时间内的确无法踏入七重境。”
有位长老沉声说道，使得众人的目光俱都落在萧沉身上。
这么说来，真有可能是萧沉帮助白念冰破境了？
“荒唐，整个远风城数十万武修，苦海九重的强者不超过一手之数，此子不过是周家想要杀的废人，你们真相信他能帮助你们登临九重境？”
白家大长老也被困在八重巅峰多年，心中虽然渴望，但他也深知，这是他夺取白家大权的唯一机会！
“你可以不相信，随你。”
萧沉转过身，不再理会白家大长老，而是望向了白家众人。
“各位长老，事已至此，就算萧沉不能成功，我们也不损失什么。
可若是成功，我们白家的整体实力，将跨出一大步！”
白念冰的话让不少长老动容了，信他一次，试一试，又何妨呢？
“不过，想要我帮忙，我有两个条件。”
萧沉见众人意动，开口说道。
“你还有条件？”
白家大长老冷哂。

“其一，想要破境之人，需得我答应。”
听到这话，不少人立即看向了大长老，大长老压迫白念冰跪下，又想杀萧沉，若说萧沉最不愿意帮谁，恐怕就是他了。
“能否做到尚未可知，便摆出这副姿态吗？”
大长老冷哼一声，似极为不悦。
“若想破境，是我等有求于萧兄弟，此言，很合理。”
有中年迈步而来，望着萧沉等人笑了笑。
“二叔！”
白念冰亲切地喊了一声。
萧沉对着他微微点头示意，随即又道，“其二，想要破境的长老，必须答应，从今往后，白念冰获得白家的绝对掌控权，其意志，任何人不得违抗！”
“不可能！”
白家大长老当即出声反对，想让他听从白念冰的号令，痴心妄想！
白念冰的美眸有些凝固，萧沉的第二个条件，竟是为她铺路吗？
“我没有意见。”
白二叔笑着道。
长老们相互对视了一眼，白二叔修为苦海七重，若是破境，便和他们同境，可担任长老。
“就让他试一试吧。”
众人皆怀着这样的心思，萧沉开出的条件，第一条倒没什么，只是这第二条，他们一时还难以接受。
“诸位可以慢慢考虑，也许，我会改变主意。”
萧沉笑着离去，只留下犹豫不决的长老们。
“就这样放他们走吗？那周家的宣战怎么办？”

大长老厉声质问，但却没有人回应他，也不知他们心里都在想些什么。
“前辈如此信任我？”
院内，萧沉有些惊讶地对着白二叔问道。
“我相信念冰。”
content_en:
Chapter 9 Zhou Lingxue’s Threat “Great Elder, wait!”
Several elders came out to stop the great elder.
Xiao Chen's words made their hearts feel like dead trees blooming, and they could not suppress the excitement in their hearts.
They have been trapped in the eighth level of the sea of ​​suffering for several years or even decades, and they dream of breaking out of this shackles.
"It's true. It was with the help of Brother Xiao that I broke through to the seventh level of the Sea of Bitter Realm."
Bai Nianbing spoke, and at the same time his aura circulated, revealing his realm.
"I remember that Nian Bing only entered the sixth level of the Sea of Bitter Realm two months ago. It is true that he will not be able to enter the seventh level in a short time."
An elder said in a deep voice, causing everyone's eyes to fall on Xiao Chen.
So, is it really possible that Xiao Chen helped Bai Nianbing break through the realm?
"It's ridiculous. There are hundreds of thousands of martial arts cultivators in Yuanfeng City, and there are no more than one strong person in the ninth level of Bitter Sea. This son is just a useless person that the Zhou family wants to kill. Do you really believe that he can help you reach the ninth level?"
The great elder of the Bai family has also been trapped in the eighth level peak for many years. Although he longs for it, he also knows that this is his only chance to seize the power of the Bai family!
"You don't have to believe it, that's up to you."
Xiao Chen turned around, no longer paying attention to the elder of the Bai family, but looked at everyone in the Bai family.
"Elders, the matter has come to this, even if Xiao Chen fails to succeed, we will not lose anything.
But if it succeeds, the overall strength of our Bai family will take a big step forward! "
Bai Nianbing's words moved many elders. Why not believe him once and give it a try?
"However, if you want my help, I have two conditions."
Xiao Chen saw everyone's movements and spoke.
"Do you still have conditions?"
The eldest elder of the Bai family was cold.
"First, those who want to break through the situation need my permission."
After hearing this, many people immediately looked at the First Elder. The First Elder forced Bai Nianbing to kneel down and wanted to kill Xiao Chen. If Xiao Chen was least willing to help anyone, it was probably him.
"You don't know whether you can do it, so why do you assume this posture?"
The Great Elder snorted coldly, seeming extremely displeased.
"If we want to break through the situation, it is we who need help from Brother Xiao. This is very reasonable."
A middle-aged man stepped forward, looked at Xiao Chen and others and smiled.
"Second uncle!"
Bai Nianbing shouted kindly.
Xiao Chen nodded slightly at him, and then said, "Secondly, the elders who want to break through must agree. From now on, Bai Nianbing will have absolute control over the Bai family, and no one can defy his will!"
"Impossible!"
The eldest elder of the Bai family immediately objected, wanting him to obey Bai Nianbing's orders, wishful thinking!
Bai Nianbing's beautiful eyes were a little frozen. Was Xiao Chen's second condition paving the way for her?
"I have no objection."
Uncle Bai said with a smile.
The elders looked at each other. Uncle Bai had cultivated to the seventh level of the Sea of ​​Bitterness. If he broke through, he would be in the same realm as them and could serve as an elder.
"Just let him try it."
Everyone had this in mind. The first condition offered by Xiao Chen was nothing, but the second condition was difficult for them to accept for the moment.
"You can think about it slowly, maybe I will change my mind."
Xiao Chen left with a smile, leaving only the hesitant elders.
"Just let them go like this? What about the Zhou family's declaration of war?"
The great elder asked sternly, but no one responded to him, and he didn't know what they were thinking.
"Senior, do you trust me so much?"
In the courtyard, Xiao Chen asked Uncle Bai in surprise.
"I believe in Xin Bing."
